## Source-only confidence clarification after section20

Section16 selects A CANCEL01 literal strike path with high shape confidence; its observed curved geometry carries one C/H graphical count. P01, the common successive-row layout, is high confidence and has no C/H count. The join component records preserve the recognizable square-form glyph at high confidence and its cancellation/live state at low confidence under the one physical parent count. This clarification refers to already inspected sections16/18 and adds no image view. Root reviewed the full selected TeX; two empty lines inside the bottom display are being removed to avoid paragraph tokens in math, with fresh exact source offsets. No ink choice changes.
